name: Species sticking, residence-time, and re-emission distribution verification
purpose: Verify compiled surface-temperature and sticking kernels while explicitly separating absent residence-time/inventory physics.
production_capability: Legacy surface-temperature/sticking kernels plus explicit Na/Ar sticking, residence-time, and integrated desorption-probability kernels.
configuration: Legacy regression controls; explicit Na table and 1.85 eV, 1e13 s^-1 residence law; input-selectable linear-speed or kinetic-energy accommodation; Ar modified Arrhenius Q=28 kJ mol^-1.
independent_reference: Closed-form cosine law, frozen legacy controls, linear table interpolation, h/(kT) exp(Q/RT), 1-exp(-dt/tau), and Tenishev et al. (2013) Eq. 14 evaluated independently.
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred solar-orbital frame; static non-eclipsed fixture.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Kernel calls are deterministic; stochastic Bernoulli/re-emission distributions remain for linked testing.
procedure: Call compiled legacy and new production kernels at breakpoints, compare residence/desorption results to direct closed-form evaluations, and parse the committed M2 receipt through Moon::Runtime::ParseApplicationInput to verify that its independent Na/Ar model and coefficient selections reach runtime configuration.
metrics: parsed Na/Ar accommodation model and coefficient
acceptance_criteria: Control values within 1e-14 relative or exact where integral; all probabilities in [0,1].
expected_pass_result: Available deterministic kernels match their frozen references.
expected_failure_modes: documented M2 surface key is not accepted or retained by the production parser
data_hashes: none; the input-resident Fig. 3 Na digitization is a production parameter, not independent observational validation
status_semantics: PASS covers deterministic temperature/sticking/residence kernels; stochastic re-emission and linked particle/inventory wiring remain I18/I19.
